Question 4
?

The velocity vector v=⟨u,v⟩ of a particle P at time t is given by v=⟨t2,e2t⟩. Calculate the acceleration vector a.

a
a=⟨t,e2t⟩
b
 a=⟨2t,e2t⟩
c
a=⟨t2,e2t2⟩
d
a=⟨2t,2e2t⟩
e
a=⟨t2,e2t4⟩
